title: Suppression of regulatory factor X 7 alleviates airway remodeling and inflammation in childhood asthma.
authors: Wu, Yahui; Dai, Tiansheng; Qin, Jingwen; Guo, Jian; Fan, Jitao; Mei, Jun; Li, Xiaoli; Liu, Fang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RFX7在儿童哮喘中的表达及功能，仅用机器学习做诊断分类，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Childhood asthma is a chronic heterogeneous syndrome composed of distinct disease entities or phenotypes. This study was conducted to characterize regulatory factor X 7 (RFX7) in childhood asthma. MATERIAL AND METHODS: Two available transcriptome datasets (GSE65204 and GSE27011) were used to analyze regulatory factor X (RFX) family members in childhood asthma. Random forest, logistic regression, and linear support vector machine (SVM) analyses were performed to construct an RFX-based classification model. Airway smooth muscle cells (ASMCs) were induced through platelet-derived growth factor-BB (PDGF-BB) for an asthma in vitro model. RFX7 expression was measured through immunoblotting. RFX7 was knocked out by transfection of RFX7 small-interfering RNAs, and then airway remodeling and inflammation were assayed. RESULTS: Among RFX family members, RFX3, RFX7, and RFX-associated protein displayed differential expression in childhood asthma versus healthy controls. Thus, SVM, logistic regression, and random forest-based machine learning models were built. The random forest model presented the best diagnostic efficacy (area under the curve [AUC] = 1 and 0.67 in discovery and verification sets). RFX7 was found to be effective in diagnosing childhood asthma (AUC = 0.724 and 0.775 in discovery and verification sets). In addition, RFX7 was overexpressed in PDGF-BB-stimulated ASMCs ((sextile) (sextile) P < 0.01). Silencing RFX7 remarkably attenuated the proliferative and migrative capacities of ASMCs with PDGF-BB stimulation ((sextile) (sextile) P < 0.01). In addition, RFX7 was positively related to neutrophil infiltration in childhood asthma, and its knockdown downregulated the levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines in PDGF-BB-stimulated ASMCs ((sextile) (sextile) P < 0.01). CONCLUSION: The findings of this study indicate that RFX7 is a novel molecule that is correlated with airway remodeling and inflammation in childhood asthma, providing insights into the mechanism underlying this disease and its potential clinical importance.
abstract_zh: 目的：儿童哮喘是一种由不同疾病实体或表型组成的慢性异质性综合征。本研究旨在表征儿童哮喘中的调控因子X 7（RFX7）。材料与方法：利用两个可用的转录组数据集（GSE65204和GSE27011）分析儿童哮喘中调控因子X（RFX）家族成员。采用随机森林、逻辑回归和线性支持向量机（SVM）分析构建基于RFX的分类模型。通过血小板衍生生长因子-BB（PDGF-BB）诱导气道平滑肌细胞（ASMCs）建立哮喘体外模型。通过免疫印迹法检测RFX7表达。通过转染RFX7小干扰RNA敲除RFX7，然后检测气道重塑和炎症。结果：在RFX家族成员中，RFX3、RFX7和RFX相关蛋白在儿童哮喘与健康对照中表现出差异表达。因此，构建了SVM、逻辑回归和基于随机森林的机器学习模型。随机森林模型在发现集和验证集中表现出最佳诊断效能（曲线下面积[AUC] = 1和0.67）。RFX7被发现能有效诊断儿童哮喘（发现集和验证集中AUC = 0.724和0.775）。此外，RFX7在PDGF-BB刺激的ASMCs中过表达（(sextile) (sextile) P < 0.01）。沉默RFX7显著减弱了PDGF-BB刺激下ASMCs的增殖和迁移能力（(sextile) (sextile) P < 0.01）。此外，RFX7与儿童哮喘中的中性粒细胞浸润呈正相关，其敲低下调了PDGF-BB刺激的ASMCs中促炎细胞因子的水平（(sextile) (sextile) P < 0.01）。结论：本研究结果表明，RFX7是一种与儿童哮喘气道重塑和炎症相关的新型分子，为该疾病的潜在机制及其临床重要性提供了见解。
